name: tides_services_latest
title: tides_services_latest
description:
Current-version cut of tides_services (`WHERE _is_current`). Exported to
the TIDES bucket at a stable path as the latest service reference
snapshot.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Synthetic version surrogate; unique per service version.

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description:
Airtable source record ID of the service. Join key from
tides_provider_gtfs_data.service_source_record_id.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Service name.

fields.name: service_type
fields.description: Comma-separated service types (e.g. fixed-route, demand-response).

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Comma-separated transit modes (e.g. bus, rail, ferry).

fields.name: operating_counties
fields.description: Comma-separated counties in which the service operates.

fields.name: fixed_route
fields.description: Whether the service is fixed route.

fields.name: is_public
fields.description: Whether the service is public.

fields.name: public_currently_operating
fields.description: Whether the service is currently operating public transit.

fields.name: public_currently_operating_fixed_route
fields.description: Whether the service is currently operating public fixed-route transit.

fields.name: operational_status
fields.description: Operational status of the service.

fields.name: _valid_from
fields.description: Timestamp from which this record version is valid (inclusive).

fields.name: _valid_to
fields.description: Timestamp until which this record version is valid.

fields.name: _is_current
fields.description: Whether this is the current version of the record.
